one_liner.text: 72-year-old woman with atrial fibrillation and a prior pulmonary embolism, on warfarin, presenting with chest pain and shortness of breath.

chief_complaint.text: Chest pain and shortness of breath, onset approximately 12:40; arrived by EMS 13:20.

relevant_history.text: Atrial fibrillation (2021), rate-controlled on metoprolol at last cardiology review.
Segmental pulmonary embolism, right lower lobe, March 2023; anticoagulation started that admission.

active_medications.text: Metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO twice daily.
Medication list last reconciled 2025-06-02 — approximately 14 months before this encounter.

allergies.text: CONFLICTING — a 2023 discharge summary documents a penicillin allergy (rash); today's triage note records no known drug allergies. Requires confirmation.

current_findings.text: ECG (13:41): atrial fibrillation ~96, no acute ST-segment elevation, non-specific lateral T-wave flattening.
13:45 vitals: BP 150/88, HR 96 irregular, RR 20, SpO2 94% on room air.
Aspirin 324 mg given by EMS at 13:05 per protocol.

outstanding.text: No INR result on file despite documented warfarin therapy.
Allergy status requires confirmation — records disagree.
